run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T01:43:24Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by real error telemetry: frontend-proxy's ingress and 'router frontend egress' spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR (ffd12667-f324-44d2-9a5b-25ba7560baf5-t0:741d2be7-b665-4655-ac1e-3907e3f3b127), rising from a 20:00-01:40 background of ~0.004-0.011 errors/s to 0.228/s at 01:45 and 0.811/s at 01:50 (e381ce8c-8ff6-45f8-9474-6fe80cd1c2a8-t1:7c06e924-d06f-4e77-8d76-19b965373529). The failing hop is frontend: frontend's error spans are on grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, GET /api/data and 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' (1d444e65-5b1e-4747-bd31-19d494fd0eba-t1:70b2244e-5eb6-41a4-8b2f-b7bd3e5f61cf), and frontend-proxy access logs show HTTP 500 on GET /api/data?contextKeys=... served via upstream 'frontend' while /api/cart, /api/products and /api/recommendations return 200 (2f1498cf-8af9-46c2-89a1-c3aa6c8975bb-t0:dbf234df-55dc-4448-9aef-b1963841abd7). The dependency behind that hop is ad: ad's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span rate fell from ~0.8/s to 0.52/s (01:45), 0.337/s (01:46), 0.148/s (01:47) and 0 from 01:48 onward (3b3c7bbf-2ab7-4f07-9a8f-f586e6ccbbd6-t2:85b7e07c-d1a4-466c-a962-c8efb009dd49), its container 'ad' was OOMKilled with exit code 137 at 01:42:53 (48706258-f26e-47ec-9c67-208e209ae4e5-t0:90186486-2bb2-41f1-916d-479a49211cbf), and its newest log line is 01:42:50.817 with nothing after the 01:42:54 restart (a2b0c674-6908-4193-829d-7cc8b09de6c2-t2:efecb54d-5c49-494e-a59e-a12062e217de). The object applying a fault to that pod is the chaos-mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos' in namespace chaos-mesh: it spawned JVMChaos experiments every ~60 s from 01:42:18 and each one reported 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad' (first at 01:42:28, then 01:43:28, 01:44:33 ... 01:50:34) followed by TimeUp/Recovered (c12a48fc-c277-43e7-ba72-73927e86eb69-t0:73d8be12-495f-462b-85cf-036c4b94cac4). Ad's working set peaked at 420 MB just before the OOMKill and the replacement container climbed from 146 MB to 373 MB against a 450Mi limit (2f1498cf-8af9-46c2-89a1-c3aa6c8975bb-t1:7cdf801b-911c-4e91-af63-8f5bb64a1db0). Because the JVMChaos/Schedule specs could not be read, the exact injected action (exception, latency, memory/GC stress) is a hypothesis and the conclusion is partial; the chaos events are the only evidence naming the fault applier.

claims.text: At the alert instant 01:43:24Z frontend-proxy's trace error metric was still low: span_name 'ingress' with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0.00556/s and 'router frontend egress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0 per second (10m rate); the same service's UNSET spans were ~11.45/s.

frontend-proxy error spans were background-level (~0.004-0.011/s, max 0.0148/s) from 01:20 to the 01:40 sample, then rose to 0.228/s (01:45), 0.811/s (01:50), and by a 1-minute-step series to 0.452/s at 01:45, 1.537/s at 01:48 and 1.789/s at 01:53.

Only frontend and frontend-proxy show elevated error spans after 01:43: frontend 0.916/s (01:45) rising to 3.563/s (01:53), frontend-proxy 0.452/s to 1.789/s; ad stayed at ~0.0037/s (flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream only), and accounting, checkout, payment and recommendation were 0 in the same samples.

frontend's own error spans are concentrated on span_name 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', 'GET /api/data', 'executing api route (pages) /api/data', 'GET' and 'tcp.connect' (each 0.221/s at the 01:45 sample, 0.815/s at 01:50), while 'GET /api/cart', 'POST /api/checkout' and the cart/checkout client spans stayed 0.

frontend-proxy access logs show HTTP 500 responses for 'GET /api/data?contextKeys=...' via upstream 'frontend' at container timestamps 01:47:14.676Z, 01:47:14.812Z, 01:47:15.107Z, 01:47:15.508Z, 01:47:15.608Z, 01:47:15.681Z, while requests to /api/cart, /api/products/* and /api/recommendations in the same lines returned 200/308.

ad's server-side span rate for oteldemo.AdService/GetAds was steady at 0.74-0.87/s from 01:25 to 01:44 and then decayed to 0.521/s (01:45), 0.337/s (01:46), 0.148/s (01:47) and stayed 0 from 01:48 through 01:54; ad's getAdsByCategory, getRandomAds and oteldemo.AdService/GetAds series all show 0 at the 01:50 sample.

Pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 container 'ad' (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) has restartCount 1 with lastState terminated reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, startedAt 2026-11-18T01:05:52Z, finishedAt 2026-11-18T01:42:53Z; the running container started 01:42:54Z and the pod's Ready condition is True since 01:42:54Z, with memory limit 450Mi and request 225Mi.

The newest log line available for the ad container is 2026-11-18T01:42:50.817405901Z (15 newest of 2744 lines read; stream read-through 01:42:50.817Z), i.e. no ad stdout was observed after the 01:42:54 restart; the lines before it are 'no baggage found in context' / 'Targeted ad request received for [...]' only.

In namespace chaos-mesh the Schedule named otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos emitted 'Create new object: otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos-<id>' (reason Spawned) at 01:42:18, 01:43:18, 01:44:29, 01:45:25, 01:46:21, 01:47:18, 01:48:31, 01:49:28, 01:50:26 and 01:51:25, and each spawned JVMChaos reported 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad' (Applied) at 01:42:28, 01:43:28, 01:44:33, 01:45:27, 01:46:24, 01:47:23, 01:48:36, 01:49:38 and 01:50:34, followed by TimeUp and Recovered.

ad container memory working set (cgroup id cri-containerd-a9304b54... of the OOMKilled instance) held ~309-312 MB from 01:25 to 01:42 and peaked at 420,438,016 bytes at the 01:43 max_over_time step; the replacement cgroup cri-containerd-ed742b64... rose from 2.6 MB (01:43) to 146 MB (01:44), 195 MB (01:45), 248 MB (01:46), 297 MB (01:47), 354 MB (01:49-01:51) and 373 MB (01:52-01:54).

The flagd-config ConfigMap (key demo.flagd.json) read at 01:55 has defaultVariant "off" and state ENABLED for adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure; no fault flag is read as switched on.

The ad Service endpoints contain the running pod: Endpoints 'ad' in otel-demo lists address 100.96.4.112 with targetRef Pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 on port 8080 (name tcp-service), so pod-to-Service registration was present when queried.

Pre-incident baseline from Jaeger: at 01:18:31-01:18:32 frontend's 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' span completed with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 in 201,252 us and its parent 'GET /api/data' returned http.status_code=200, i.e. the ad path was working before the chaos experiments and OOMKill.

The immediately preceding OOMKill in the cluster was a different pod: ad-554b849958-fcl25's own lastState shows OOMKilled only at 01:42:53, while fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-wbm7f was OOMKilled at 01:20:25 (exit 137) and fraud-detection's own error span rate was 0 in every sample from 01:00 to 01:53, so that earlier restart does not explain the ad-path failures.

The JVMChaos experiments applied to container 'ad' by Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos are what disrupted the ad JVM: ad's working set jumped from ~310 MB to 420 MB and the container was OOMKilled 25 s after the first 'Applied' event (01:42:28 -> 01:42:53), and after the restart the ad container emitted no logs and no GetAds spans, so frontend's AdService/GetAds calls fail, /api/data returns 500 and frontend-proxy records ingress/egress errors. The specific injected action and its parameters are not visible in the events.

Ad's 450Mi memory limit is tight against its observed working set (420 MB peak in the killed container, 373 MB and still climbing in the replacement), so the limit is a plausible contributing factor to the OOMKill, but the growth itself may be the effect of the injected JVM chaos.

A fault-injection feature flag being switched on in flagd is not the trigger: the flagd-config flags adFailure, adHighCpu and adManualGc (the ad-related fault settings) all read defaultVariant "off" when read at 01:55, and no other object besides the chaos Schedule is seen applying a fault to the ad pod.

A Service/Endpoints misconfiguration for 'ad' is not the cause: Endpoints 'ad' contains the pod address 100.96.4.112:8080, and frontend's failures are RPC-level on grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (~0.81/s) with only a much smaller tcp.connect error rate (0.033/s at 01:45, 0.015/s at 01:50), so most calls were not refused by routing.

Human follow-up should read the chaos-mesh JVMChaos/Schedule 'otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos' spec (action, duration, target method) and the chaos-controller-manager logs for the experiments otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos-4c7dg/tdvvl/7fjbx/7zk5w/t8tf2/9jglq/9626f/t4jlc/452d7/qttkp to identify the injected fault, and decide whether that experiment is intended for this environment.

If the ad JVM's ~25 MB/min working-set growth in the post-restart container is real, raise the ad container's 450Mi memory limit or set a JVM heap ceiling, and re-check whether ad resumes exporting oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans and stdout.

gaps: The chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos and its JVMChaos children could not be read (kind not available to the tools); the injected action (exception/latency/memory/GC stress), target method, duration and selector are unknown, so the causal step from JVMChaos to ad's OOMKill and non-serving state is a hypothesis based on event timing.
chaos-controller-manager and chaos-daemon container logs returned 0 bytes, so no controller-side detail of the experiments was readable.
frontend's container produced no readable log lines in the whole authorized window (0 bytes read), so the frontend-side error text behind the /api/data 500s was not observed.

Jaeger held no traces after 01:18:32 (data_as_of 2026-11-18T01:18:32Z): traces_search and traces_search_by_tags returned nothing for frontend-proxy, frontend error=true and ad in the incident window, so the gRPC error code/detail of the failing AdService/GetAds calls could not be read.

The alert's own rule and value could not be verified: list_prometheus_rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no_data, and http_server_request_duration_seconds_count had no series in the window; the alert annotation value 1.5333 does not match the trace error rate sampled at 01:43:24 (0.00556/s ingress, 0 egress), so which expression produced that number is unknown.
rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_* and rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_* returned no series for service_name 'ad' or in general, so ad gRPC latency from those metrics is unknown.

Frontend-proxy access-log line text embeds an inner timestamp '[2025-12-15T17:58:...]' that disagrees with the container timestamp (2026-11-18T01:47:...); the 500-on-/api/data lines are therefore dated only by the container timestamp, and log coverage beyond the newest 40 of 4922 matching lines was not read.
No sample after 01:54:39Z was examined, so whether the chaos Schedule is still spawning experiments and whether frontend-proxy errors have subsided after 01:54 is unknown.
